proposals.title: Proposal 7. Shareholder Proposal Seeking a Simple Majority Vote
proposals.topic_summary: Replace each supermajority voting requirement in the charter and bylaws with a majority of votes cast for and against, or a simple majority.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends you vote AGAINST the following proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal 8. Shareholder Proposal Seeking an Amendment to Existing Clawback Provisions
proposals.proponent: United Steel, Paper and Forestry, Rubber, Manufacturing, Energy, Allied Industrial and Service Workers International Union
proposals.topic_summary: Expand the clawback policy to recoup incentive pay when executives' conduct or risk failures cause financial or reputational harm, and disclose such decisions.
proposals.evidence: The Board has carefully considered this proposal and recommends you vote AGAINST it.

proposals.title: Proposal 9. Shareholder Proposal Seeking a Report on Just Transition
proposals.proponent: International Brotherhood of Teamsters General Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Prepare a report on how the climate strategy affects workers and communities, consistent with ILO Just Transition guidelines, with measurable indicators.
proposals.evidence: The Board has carefully considered this proposal and recommends you vote AGAINST it.

proposals.title: Proposal 10. Shareholder Proposal Seeking an Audited Report on Asset Retirement Obligations
proposals.proponent: State of New Jersey Common Pension Fund D
proposals.topic_summary: Issue an audited report disclosing undiscounted expected costs to settle asset retirement obligations with indeterminate settlement dates by February 2024.
proposals.evidence: The Board has carefully considered this proposal and recommends you vote AGAINST it.
